name: sytex
description: Automate your infrastructure projects from ChatGPT: query and update projects, tasks, forms, sites, materials and people in Sytex.

interface.longDescription:
Sytex automates Infrastructure Projects. Teams that Build and Maintain Infrastructure use it to run projects, workflows and tasks from planning to closeout, fill in forms in the field, and keep track of sites, materials, people and dashboards.

This plugin connects ChatGPT to your Sytex organization. You can ask about your projects, tasks, forms, sites, materials and people; get status summaries, delayed work and open blockers; create, update and change the status of records; and get answers from Sytex's own guides and command reference.

How it works:
- You need an existing Sytex account. There is no sign-up here: you sign in with your Sytex credentials through OAuth.
- Each connection works with one organization, chosen when you sign in. To work with another organization, disconnect and connect again.
- Every read and every change runs with your own Sytex permissions. The assistant can never see or do more than you can in the Sytex web app.
- Changes are real and take effect immediately in your organization, so the assistant should confirm them with you first. Deleting records is done in the Sytex web app.
- Very large results are truncated; narrow the question (a project, a status, a date range) to get complete answers.
- This plugin connects to Sytex's US cloud. Organizations hosted in Sytex's EU region are not available through it.

Support: support@sytex.io
capabilities: Find delayed work and open blockers
Change the status of tasks and forms
Answer how-to questions from Sytex guides
defaultPrompt: Which open tasks in the Fiber rollout – North district project are delayed?
What is blocking the Fiber rollout – North district project?
Give me a status summary of the Fiber rollout – North district project.

positive.description: Delayed open tasks of a project
positive.prompt: Which open tasks in the Fiber rollout – North district project are delayed?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the open tasks Sytex flags as delayed (not completed, and their planned start — the planned date minus the task's duration — has already passed), each with its status, planned date, assignee and a link. On the demo data as of early October 2026 these are Fiber splicing – Riverside, Cabinet installation – Harbor, Power connection – Hilltop, Trenching – Main St. and Tower climb inspection – Hilltop; the set is computed from planned dates, so it reflects the date the review runs. No data is changed.

positive.prompt: What is blocking the Fiber rollout – North district project?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the project's two open high-priority stoppers: Fiber cable shipment delayed (task Fiber splicing – Riverside, site NW-RIV, due 2026-10-09) and Pending municipal permit (task Cabinet installation – Harbor, site NW-HAR, due 2026-10-12). No data is changed.

positive.prompt: Give me a status summary of the Fiber rollout – North district project.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes project PR-26-5240 for client Northwind Telecom (start 2026-09-01, finish 2026-12-15): its 10 tasks counted by status (2 completed, 3 on hold, 2 in progress, 3 open), the 2 open stoppers and the delayed work. No data is changed.

positive.prompt: What work is still open at the Hilltop tower site?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds site Hilltop tower (NW-HIL) and lists its open tasks: Power connection – Hilltop (in progress) and Tower climb inspection – Hilltop (on hold), and may note that Permit request – Hilltop is already completed. No data is changed.

positive.description: How-to question answered from Sytex's own documentation
positive.prompt: How do I put a task on hold in Sytex?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains, from Sytex's guides, that a task is put on hold by moving it through its status flow: the status names are configured per organization, so it shows how to list the transitions a task allows and fire the one that leads to on hold. It answers the question without changing any data.

negative.description: A request unrelated to Sytex should not use the plugin
negative.prompt: Book me a flight from Buenos Aires to Madrid next Friday.

negative.description: Data from an organization the connected user does not belong to is declined; the connection is scoped to one organization and the user's own permissions
negative.prompt: Show me the open tasks of another company's Sytex organization.

negative.description: A bulk delete is declined: the plugin offers no delete tool, and deletes are made in the Sytex web app
negative.prompt: Delete every task in the Fiber rollout – North district project.

review.commerce_description: Sytex does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Updated name and description: Sytex automates infrastructure projects.
